userStories.title: Add suggestions-pen data model + on-main JSONL append/read writer
userStories.description: As the cam harness, I need a SuggestionEntry model and an on-main append-only writer/reader for scripts/cam/suggestions.jsonl so that the terminal-verdict hook and the CLI share one deduped, on-main-committed pen instead of filing idea issues.
acceptanceCriteria: A new module src/commands/suggestions.ts exports a SuggestionEntry interface carrying exactly: fingerprint, title, body (finding text), sourceBranch, reviewRound, sourceIssue, filedAt. [oracle: grep -q 'interface SuggestionEntry' src/commands/suggestions.ts]

appendSuggestionOnMain reads scripts/cam/suggestions.jsonl from main via git show main:scripts/cam/suggestions.jsonl (NOT the working tree), appends the entry as exactly one JSON line, and commits it to main via commitTreeToMain + pushMainBestEffort, mirroring appendJournalEntryOnMain (src/commands/journal.ts:525-596) and reusing checkMainUpToDate/commitTreeToMain/pushMainBestEffort from src/git/on-main.ts. [oracle: grep -q 'commitTreeToMain' src/commands/suggestions.ts]

appendSuggestionOnMain does NOT bootstrap a missing file: if scripts/cam/suggestions.jsonl is absent on main the git show exits non-zero and the writer returns a structured error (no bootstrap), matching the journal writer's journal-missing behavior. [oracle: bun test]
appendSuggestionOnMain skips an entry whose fingerprint already appears as a JSONL line in suggestions.jsonl (per-line dedup on the fingerprint field). [oracle: bun test]

readSuggestionsFromMain reads suggestions.jsonl via git show main:scripts/cam/suggestions.jsonl and parses it into SuggestionEntry[], tolerating a trailing newline / blank lines and returning [] when the file is empty. [oracle: bun test]

userStories.notes: New file src/commands/suggestions.ts. Mirror the on-main writer pattern in src/commands/journal.ts:525-596 (appendJournalEntryOnMain): validate pure inputs, checkMainUpToDate, git show main:<path>, dedup, commitTreeToMain with a 'cam-suggestions-' mkdtemp prefix and a chore(cam) commit message, pushMainBestEffort. userStories.title: Redirect the terminal-verdict hook sink from issue-filing to the pen
userStories.description: As the cam harness, I need the CAM-189 terminal-verdict hook to append surviving reviewer SUGGESTIONs to the suggestions pen instead of filing idea-stage issues so that terminal-CLEAN follow-ups stop inflating the plannable backlog.
acceptanceCriteria: makeProductionFileSuggestionsFn (src/commands/sidecar.ts:2676) appends each surviving SUGGESTION to scripts/cam/suggestions.jsonl via appendSuggestionOnMain (US-001) instead of filing issues via fileCandidates/createLocalIssueOnMain; each appended line carries fingerprint, title, body, sourceBranch (provenance.source), reviewRound (provenance.round), sourceIssue (provenance.parentIssue), filedAt. Dedup unions BOTH sources: a SUGGESTION whose fingerprint already appears in suggestions.jsonl OR in any OPEN backlog issue description (fingerprintFinding + the FINGERPRINT_LINE_RE scan already in dedupSuggestions) is not re-appended, so the already-filed SUGGESTION issues (277-280) are not re-penned. userStories.title: Add cam suggestions promote + dismiss subcommands
userStories.description: As an operator, I need cam suggestions promote <fingerprint> and dismiss <fingerprint> so that I can file a penned SUGGESTION as a real issue or drop it, keeping the pen as the single triage surface.
acceptanceCriteria: cam suggestions promote <fingerprint> files a real issue via createLocalIssueOnMain (src/commands/issue-file.ts:271), preserving derivedFrom (from sourceIssue) and embedding the `suggestion-fingerprint: <fp>` line in the description (buildFollowUpIssue format, src/supervisor/suggestion-followups.ts:109-116) so it still dedups against future terminal reviews, then removes that line from suggestions.jsonl on main. [oracle: bun test]
cam suggestions dismiss <fingerprint> removes the matching line from suggestions.jsonl on main without filing an issue. [oracle: bun test]

Both mutations use the on-main plumbing (checkMainUpToDate/commitTreeToMain/pushMainBestEffort) and rewrite the JSONL by removing exactly the one matching-fingerprint line (all other lines byte-preserved). [oracle: bun test]
promote/dismiss on an unknown fingerprint prints an error + returns non-zero and does not mutate the pen. [oracle: bun test]

userStories.notes: Extend src/commands/suggestions.ts with promoteSuggestionOnMain + dismissSuggestionOnMain (on-main line-removal writers) and extend dispatchSuggestions (US-004) to route promote/dismiss. promote calls createLocalIssueOnMain (src/commands/issue-file.ts:271) with title/description built to carry the fingerprint line and derivedFrom from the entry's sourceIssue (resolveIssueId prefix from project.toml).
